Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My read on the situation is that by 'personnel' they mean 'covert operatives'. You don't hire 'Mechs to cover the retreat of clerical staff.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我对这个局面的解读是，他们说的"人员"其实指的是"秘密特工"。你不会雇机甲来掩护文员的撤退。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our covert forces are poised to seize a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} prison facility where a large number of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being held prisoner. However, the facility is protected by a nearby military base, and as soon as we seize the prison, they'll move against it, and reduce those buildings to rubble before they let us extract those people. We'll be moving our own 'Mechs and Leopards in as quickly as we can but before we can land them and extract the personnel, we need you to pacify that military base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的隐蔽部队已准备好夺取一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}监狱设施，那里关押着大量{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员。然而，该设施受附近一处军事基地保护，我们一夺取监狱，他们就会对监狱动手，在让我们撤出那些人之前把这些建筑夷为瓦砾。我们会尽快调动自己的机甲与豹式，但在我们能让它们降落并撤出人员之前，我们需要你压制那座军事基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has landed nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队已在附近着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Acknowledged. Meyer, how long have we got before the bad guys respond?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白了. 梅耶尔，在敌人反应之前我们，多久了?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another enemy lance in the AO, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务区的另一个敌方长枪，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another job well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一项任务圆满完成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our facility is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们这边的设施正在遭到射击。我们需要你引开火力，否则我们就死定了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our forces are ready to assist in defending the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，我们的部队已准备好协助保卫基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, we're under heavy-- [static]-- hold out-- [static]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们遭到猛烈—— [静电] ——坚守—— [静电]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, we've taken control of the facility. Our DropShips are on station; as soon as the area's secure we'll start evacuating our people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们已控制设施。我们的空投舰已就位；区域一安全我们就开始撤离人员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base secure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要你还待在作战区域，指挥官，你就得确保 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements are inbound to this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 增援正前往此处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard just dropped another lance into the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一只豹子{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}刚刚在任务区投下了另一支长枪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, enemy turrets identified.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，已识别敌方炮塔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我发现区域内有敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 单位。我们的目标叫来了盟友助阵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, more hostiles are entering the area. I've marked their LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，更多敌人正进入区域。我已标出他们的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已完成所有主要目标，你可以撤离了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got an enemy lance moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's the first target structure down, Commander. Keep up the pressure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一处目标结构已倒下，指挥官。继续保持压力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些单位不被摧毁，我们就完不成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When you're ready to extract, Sumire will pick you up at this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你准备撤离时，苏米尔会在这个位置接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Emergency Evacuation
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 紧急疏散

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm guessing these 'civilians' are some kind of covert operatives, for this much metal to be put on the field to extract them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我猜这些"平民"其实是某种秘密特工，否则不会为了把他们撤出来而投入这么多钢铁到战场上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is an extremely time-sensitive mission and we're on a strict deadline, so I hope you can assist us. Our covert forces are poised to seize a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility where a large number of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} civilians are being held prisoner. However, the facility is protected by a nearby military base, and as soon as we seize the prison, they'll move against it, and reduce those buildings to rubble before they let us extract those people. We'll be moving our own 'Mechs and Leopards in as quickly as we can but before we can land them and extract the civilians, we need you to pacify that military base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这是一个时间极为敏感的任务，我们期限很紧，所以希望你能协助。我们的隐蔽部队正准备夺取一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施，那里关押着大量{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}平民。然而该设施受到附近一处军事基地的保护，我们一旦夺取监狱，他们就会采取行动，在允许我们撤离那些人之前把那些建筑轰成瓦砾。我们会尽快投入自己的机甲与豹式，但在我方着陆并撤出平民之前，我们需要你压制那座军事基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has landed nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队已在附近着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Acknowledged. Meyer, how long have we got before the bad guys respond?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白了. 梅耶尔，在敌人反应之前我们，多久了?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another enemy lance in the AO, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务区的另一个敌方长枪，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another job well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一项任务圆满完成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our facility is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们这边的设施正在遭到射击。我们需要你引开火力，否则我们就死定了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our forces are ready to assist in defending the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，我们的部队已准备好协助保卫基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, we're under heavy-- [static]-- hold out-- [static]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们遭到猛烈—— [静电] ——坚守—— [静电]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, we've taken control of the facility. Our DropShips are on station; as soon as the area's secure we'll start evacuating our people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们已控制设施。我们的空投舰已就位；区域一安全我们就开始撤离人员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base secure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要你还待在作战区域，指挥官，你就得确保 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements are inbound to this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 增援正前往此处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard just dropped another lance into the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一只豹子{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}刚刚在任务区投下了另一支长枪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, enemy turrets identified.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，已识别敌方炮塔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我发现区域内有敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 单位。我们的目标叫来了盟友助阵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, more hostiles are entering the area. I've marked their LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，更多敌人正进入区域。我已标出他们的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已完成所有主要目标，你可以撤离了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got an enemy lance moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's the first target structure down, Commander. Keep up the pressure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一处目标结构已倒下，指挥官。继续保持压力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些单位不被摧毁，我们就完不成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When you're ready to extract, Sumire will pick you up at this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你准备撤离时，苏米尔会在这个位置接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: High Tide
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 洪水

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At least 1 must survive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 至少 1 个必须存活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attack and Defend
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻守兼备

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used to show players where the escape region is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于向玩家显示逃脱区域的位置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 'major' force sounds like a whole lot of metal on the field. Expect a long slog, Commander, and maybe pack lasers instead of autocannons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支"主力"部队听起来意味着战场上会出现一大堆钢铁。预期会是一场漫长的苦战，指挥官，也许该多带激光器而不是自动炮。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we need your assistance in fending off an attack on one of our facilities. This base is a critical logistical center for us, primarily for food and medicine; if we lose it, our forces in the region will be hamstrung. A major {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force has deployed to the region, and we've just gotten word that they've seized an auxiliary base near the logistics facility, and are using it as a staging point for a further assault. We need you to level that auxiliary base and cut off their offensive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们需要你协助击退对我方一处设施的进攻。这座基地是我们的关键后勤中心，主要用于粮食与药品；如果失去它，我们在这个地区的部队将寸步难行。一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}大型打击部队已部署到该地区，而我们刚得到消息，他们夺取了后勤设施附近的一处辅助基地，并以此为跳板发动进一步进攻。我们需要你把那座辅助基地夷平，切断他们的攻势。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好杀，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leopard inbound, boss. Looks like more {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units on the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 豹式即将进场，老板. 看来战场上又出现了更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move in to make the pickup, Meyer. Commander, your evac zone is here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让他们离开那里，梅耶尔. 指挥官，你的撤离区在这里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Some of the enemy forces are hanging back at their base, presumably to defend it from us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一些敌军仍在基地，大概是为了防御他们的攻击.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has provided some of their own forces to support us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 派出了自己的一些部队来支援我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The friendly facility is under fire, Commander. If we lose it, the mission is scrubbed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我方设施正遭受攻击，指挥官. 要是丢了它，任务就泡汤了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些单位不被摧毁，我们就完不成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're entering the AO, boss, and my board just lit up like a Christmas tree. There's a whole lot of hostiles down there, folks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在进入行动区域，老大，我的面板亮得像圣诞树。下面有一大堆敌人，各位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At least 1 must survive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 至少 1 个必须存活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attack and Defend
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻守兼备

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used to show players where the escape region is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于向玩家显示逃脱区域的位置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Given the framing, I think it's best we never investigate who these 'dear friends' are, or why they're locked up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 考虑到这个构陷，我想我们最好永远别去调查这些"亲爱的朋友"是谁，或者他们为什么被关起来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Some of our favorite people are currently being held in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} prison facility. We'd like to break them out and evacuate them, but the prison's protected by a nearby military base. We're very competent at prison breaks, but less experienced at defending bases from lances of military 'Mechs. That's where you come in! We'll seize control of the prison, and then you land and shoot anyone who tries to keep us from evacuating our dear friends. In fact, it would probably be best if you simply destroyed their base entirely. Wouldn't do to have them tracking us!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的一些好朋友目前被关押在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的一处监狱设施中。我们想把他们救出来并撤离，但监狱受到附近一座军事基地的保护。我们非常擅长劫狱，但在抵御成队军用机甲守卫基地方面经验较少。这正是需要你的地方！我们会先夺取监狱的控制权，然后你降落并射杀任何试图阻止我们撤离挚友的人。事实上，干脆把他们的基地彻底摧毁可能最好。让他们追踪到我们可就不好了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has landed nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队已在附近着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Acknowledged. Meyer, how much time have we got before the military base responds?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白了. 梅耶尔，在军事基地做出反应之前，我们还有，多长时间?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another enemy lance in the AO, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务区的另一个敌方长枪，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another job well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一项任务圆满完成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our facility is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们这边的设施正在遭到射击。我们需要你引开火力，否则我们就死定了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our forces are ready to assist in defending the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，我们的部队已准备好协助保卫基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, we're under heavy-- [static]-- hold out-- [static]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们遭到猛烈—— [静电] ——坚守—— [静电]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base secure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要你还待在作战区域，指挥官，你就得确保 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements are inbound to this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 增援正前往此处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard just dropped another lance into the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一只豹子{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}刚刚在任务区投下了另一支长枪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, enemy turrets identified.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，已识别敌方炮塔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我发现区域内有敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 单位。我们的目标叫来了盟友助阵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, more hostiles are entering the area. I've marked their LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，更多敌人正进入区域。我已标出他们的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已完成所有主要目标，你可以撤离了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got an enemy lance moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Right! We've taken control of the facility. Our evacuation DropShips are ready to start the evacuation once you've destroyed that base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好！我们已经控制了该设施。你一摧毁那座基地，我们的撤离空投艇就准备开始撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's the first target structure down, Commander. Keep up the pressure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一处目标结构已倒下，指挥官。继续保持压力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些单位不被摧毁，我们就完不成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When you're ready to extract, Sumire will pick you up at this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你准备撤离时，苏米尔会在这个位置接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At least 1 must survive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 至少 1 个必须存活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attack and Defend
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻守兼备

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used to show players where the escape region is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于向玩家显示逃脱区域的位置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll be outnumbered and outmatched, Commander, but that's hardly a new experience for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们会寡不敌众、火力也不及，指挥官，但这对我们来说不算什么新鲜事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been able to infiltrate personnel into a contested region to take control of an abandoned base. We've brought the base's primary power and communications systems online, but in doing so, we've made an unfortunate discovery: a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force has done the same thing with a nearby facility. They're somewhat ahead of us in the process, and have their base's turrets online; they're also landing troops and 'Mechs to hold their new acquisition. Only one of us can control this area when we're finished; we'd like you to ensure that it's us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已成功把人员渗透进一处争夺区，控制了一座废弃基地。我们已经让基地的主电力与通讯系统上线，但在此过程中，我们不幸发现：一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队对附近一处设施做了同样的事。他们在这过程中比我们领先一些，已经让自家基地的炮塔上线；他们还在投放部队与机甲来守住新到手的地盘。结束时只能有一方控制这片区域；我们希望你能确保是我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has landed nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队已在附近着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A new lance of enemy reinforcements has arrived.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支新的敌方增援小队已经抵达.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All right, Commander; we're already behind the competition here, so we'll need to move fast.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，指挥官；我们在这里已经落后于竞争对手，所以得行动迅速。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base secure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要你还待在作战区域，指挥官，你就得确保 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boom. One down, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轰. 干掉一个，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我发现区域内有敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 单位。我们的目标叫来了盟友助阵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已完成所有主要目标，你可以撤离了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got a lance of enemy forces moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy reinforcements just arrived on the field, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌人的增援刚刚到达，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That was their last structure, Commander. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base is rubble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那是他们最后一座建筑了，指挥官. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的基地已经成了一片废墟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has provided some of their own forces to support us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 派出了自己的一些部队来支援我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They're coming in fast, don't let them get too close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们来得很快，别让他们靠得太近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch out commander, more hostiles are arriving. They'll be landing in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，指挥官，更多敌人正在赶来。他们将在这一带着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些单位不被摧毁，我们就完不成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proxy War
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 代理战

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At least 1 must survive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 至少 1 个必须存活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attack and Defend
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻守兼备

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used to show players where the escape region is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于向玩家显示逃脱区域的位置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this mission is... insane. And I don't say that lightly. We're going to take a serious beating on this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次任务……疯了。我说这话可不是随便说的。这一仗我们会挨得很惨。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we have a developing situation and need an unorthodox solution, which we're hoping your team can provide. Six hours ago, a heavily-armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force landed near one of our research facilities and took control of it. That facility is stuffed with critical intelligence and research data, all of which is being accessed and transmitted off-planet right now. We simply don't have enough local firepower to dislodge them. We've got a plan, though. We're going to bait a third party into helping us destroy the base and its intel. You're the bait.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们出现了一个新情况，需要一个非常规的解决办法，希望你的团队能提供。六小时前，一支重武装的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}打击部队降落在我们一处研究设施附近并夺取了它。那座设施里塞满了关键情报与研究数据，而所有这些此刻正被读取并传输到行星之外。我们现有的本地火力根本不足以把他们赶走。不过我们有个计划。我们要引诱第三方来帮我们摧毁这座基地及其情报。你就是那个诱饵。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, more hostiles are entering the area. I've marked their LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，更多敌人正进入区域。我已标出他们的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we lose another building, this mission is over.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们又失去了一栋建筑. 这次任务结束了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已完成所有主要目标，你可以撤离了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got an enemy lance moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good kill, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好杀，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, guys? What was that flash I just saw from the friendly base?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，伙计们?，我刚刚在盟军基地看到的闪电是什么?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leopard inbound, boss. Looks like more {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units on the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 豹式即将进场，老板. 看来战场上又出现了更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units, Commander. Just uh, just let me know if you need me to pull you out of there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队，指挥官. 当你想离开那里时，请告诉我，嗯.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move in to make the pickup, Meyer. Commander, your evac zone is here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让他们离开那里，梅耶尔. 指挥官，你的撤离区在这里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not helpful, Meyer. Stay on station to make the pickup once the base is down. Commander... good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这没有帮助，梅耶尔. 等基地被摧毁后就进行接应. 指挥官……祝你好运.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has provided some of their own forces to support us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 派出了自己的一些部队来支援我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The friendly facility is under fire, Commander. If we lose it, the mission is scrubbed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我方设施正遭受攻击，指挥官. 要是丢了它，任务就泡汤了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些单位不被摧毁，我们就完不成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're expecting the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces to begin their assault on this facility at any moment. If they destroy it, our employers lose their eyes on the operational area; they'll scrub the mission at that point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们预计{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队随时会开始进攻这处设施。如果他们摧毁了它，我们的雇主就失去了对行动区域的监视；到那时他们会取消任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yeah, whose bullshit idea was this, anyway?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是啊. 这到底是谁出的馊主意?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At least 1 must survive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 至少 1 个必须存活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attack and Defend
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻守兼备

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used to show players where the escape region is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于向玩家显示逃脱区域的位置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got to intercept 'Mechs, destroy a base, save a base... and there are base defense systems? Sounds like a mess.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们得拦截机甲、摧毁一座基地、拯救一座基地……还有基地防御系统？听起来一团乱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've just received a distress signal from one of our facilities on the planet. A team of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorists have seized control of the primary base, executed the base commander, and subverted the base's defense systems. Satellite imagery tells us they're preparing for an assault on the secondary base. We need a rapid response force to eliminate their assault team, and level the seized base. Our own forces are inbound but won't get there in time to save the secondary base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们刚收到行星上一处设施发来的求救信号。一队{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子夺取了主基地的控制权，处决了基地指挥官，并破坏了基地的防御系统。卫星图像显示他们正准备突袭次基地。我们需要一支快速反应部队去消灭他们的突击队，并把被夺取的基地夷平。我们自己的部队正在赶来，但赶不上救下次基地。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏 - 激活敌对所有 1 轮安全计时器的标志

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HIDDEN - 用于确定所有初选是否完成的标志.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏 - 敌对所有 1 轮安全计时器

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏 - 对所有 AI 计时器充满敌意

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏 - 对所有掉落计时器都怀有敌意.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏 - 增援 2 攻击计时器

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏 - 增援 3 攻击计时器

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: HIDDEN - 等待增援警告

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的攻击者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep All Friendly Structures Standing
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让所有友方结构保持完好

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 10 - 摧毁额外部队 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 11 -- Destroy Additional {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 11 - 摧毁额外部队 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 12 -- Destroy Additional {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 12 - 摧毁额外部队 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 13 -- Destroy Additional {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 13 - 摧毁额外部队 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 14 -- Destroy Opposing {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 14 - 摧毁敌对势力 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 15 -- Destroy Opposing {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 15 - 摧毁敌对势力 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 16 -- Destroy Enemy Allied {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 16 - 消灭敌军 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 的盟友.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 17 -- Destroy Enemy Allied {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} Forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 17 - 消灭敌军 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 的盟友.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 3 - 消灭{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}攻击者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 30 -- Entire Player Lance Must Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 30 - 你的整支枪都必须存活下来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 31 -- Ensure Entire Player Lance Survives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 31 - 使，让你的整个小队活下来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 32 -- Unit One of Player Lance Must Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 32 - 你的一支长枪必须活下来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 33 -- Ensure Unit One of Player Lance Survives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 33 - 确保，您的长枪中的第一个单元幸存下来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 34 -- Friendly {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Lance Must Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 34 - 盟军长枪 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 必须生存.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 35 -- Ensure Friendly {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Lance Survives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 35 - 使，盟军长枪 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 幸存下来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obj 8 -- Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Defenders
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标 8 - 摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our facility is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们这边的设施正在遭到射击。我们需要你引开火力，否则我们就死定了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, we're under heavy-- [static]-- hold out-- [static]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们遭到猛烈—— [静电] ——坚守—— [静电]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base secure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要你还待在作战区域，指挥官，你就得确保 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boom! Good kill, boss!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轰！干得漂亮，老大！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements are inbound to this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 增援正前往此处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我发现区域内有敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 单位。我们的目标叫来了盟友助阵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已完成所有主要目标，你可以撤离了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got a lance of enemy forces moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meyer, cut the chatter and get ready for the pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 梅耶尔，别废话了. 准备好撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shit. Commander, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard just dropped another lance into the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该死. 指挥官，一艘{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的“豹式”空投艇刚刚又向任务区域投放了一支小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thanks for the assist, Argo. We can take things from here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 感谢支援，阿尔戈号. 我们可以从这里接手了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's the first target structure down, Commander. Keep up the pressure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一处目标结构已倒下，指挥官。继续保持压力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has provided some of their own forces to support us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 派出了自己的一些部队来支援我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only way to stop the attacks entirely is to break their command and control -- which means taking down that enemy facility. That should be your priority.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 要彻底阻止袭击就必须摧毁其指挥控制系统——这意味着必须攻陷那座敌方设施. 这应该是你们的首要任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They seem fairly determined to hold this facility. We need to hurry before even more of them show up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们看起来铁了心要守住这个设施. 我们得赶在更多敌人出现之前加快速度.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They're coming in fast, don't let them get too close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们来得很快，别让他们靠得太近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch out commander, more hostiles are arriving. They'll be landing in this area.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, more hostiles are entering the area. I've marked their LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，更多敌人正进入区域。我已标出他们的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're tasked with taking down a base that's been captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的任务是拿下一座被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子夺取的基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已完成所有主要目标，你可以撤离了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got an enemy lance moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meyer, cut the chatter and get ready for the pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 梅耶尔，别废话了. 准备好撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shit. Commander, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard just dropped another lance into the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该死. 指挥官，一艘{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的“豹式”空投艇刚刚又向任务区域投放了一支小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's the first target structure down, Commander. Keep up the pressure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一处目标结构已倒下，指挥官。继续保持压力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has provided some of their own forces to support us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 派出了自己的一些部队来支援我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only way to stop the attacks entirely is to break their command and control -- which means taking down that enemy facility. That should be your priority.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 要彻底阻止袭击就必须摧毁其指挥控制系统——这意味着必须攻陷那座敌方设施. 这应该是你们的首要任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They seem fairly determined to hold this facility. We need to hurry before even more of them show up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们看起来铁了心要守住这个设施. 我们得赶在更多敌人出现之前加快速度.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些单位不被摧毁，我们就完不成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你准备撤离时，苏米尔会在这个位置接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市机甲 IIC 是原版城市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级版。在黄金世纪全能机甲发展的同期，郊狼氏族技师重制了这款古老的设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的作战数据，并以此为基础进行升级。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The product of an aborted series of experiments into LAM technology, the Urbanmech LAM is not surprisingly; poorly suited for either role. Designed by the self proclaimed professor of Cluffs Stand, Mencius Horvat; using a mixture of stolen Urbanmech parts and Lostech recovered from throughout the Periphery. Slow by LAM standards and drastically under gunned by Urbanmech standards, this mech struggles to fill either role. That said, the shock factor of an Urbanmech LAM deployed against uninformed opponents, has allowed it a measure of success when used as a raider. Dual ER Mediums and a bevy of rockets provide a nasty punch at close quarters, but prove mediocre at longer ranges. The only known examples of this mech were were recovered by the DMI and were turned over to the NAIS, though their current status is unknown. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 LAM 技术一系列中途夭折的实验的产物，Urbanmech LAM 哪一种角色都不适合，这一点并不令人意外。它由自称克拉夫斯站教授的门修斯·霍瓦特设计，材料是偷来的 Urbanmech 零件和从外围地区各地回收的失落科技。按 LAM 的标准它太慢，按 Urbanmech 的标准它的火力又严重不足，无论哪个角色都难以胜任。即便如此，把它派去对付毫无防备的对手时，其震撼效果让它在充当突袭者时取得了一定成功。双联增程中型激光加上一堆火箭，在近距离能打出凶狠的一击，但在较远距离上表现平平。已知仅存的几台此型机甲被 DMI 回收并移交给了 NAIS，不过它们目前的下落不明。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Urbie LAM does something no UrbanMech should ever do. Fly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市 LAM 做了任何城市机甲都不该做的事。飞行。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为城市近战而造的R61L，在它的廉价表亲R60L的AC20之外，还升级装上了隐形设备。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重型防御者

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: R61L 为城市近战而设，在较廉价的 R60L 表亲的 AC20 之外，还加装了隐形装备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by Cataclysm, a former freeborn Clan Wolf MechWarrior turned Mercenary, and infamous UrbanMech fanatic, this refit is designed to be a cost-effective and logistically reliable way to garrison cities. For the price of a single Awesome, one could afford to refit an entire lance of UrbanMechs to the R8Q standard. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套改装由“灾变”（Cataclysm）设计——他曾是部族狼的自由出生机甲战士，后来成为雇佣兵，同时也是臭名昭著的都市机甲狂热爱好者——旨在提供一种经济实惠、后勤可靠的守城方案。以一台“超赞”（Awesome）的价钱，就足以把一整支都市机甲小队改装到 R8Q 标准。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: MP Defender
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: MP 防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by Cataclysm, a former freeborn Clan Wolf MechWarrior turned Mercenary, and infamous UrbanMech fanatic, this refit is designed to be a cost-effective and logistically reliable way to garrison cities. For the price of a single Awesome, one could afford to refit an entire lance of UrbanMechs to the R8Q standard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此改装型由"灾变"设计——一位前自由出身氏族狼机甲战士转行的佣兵，也是臭名昭著的城市机甲狂热分子——旨在提供一种成本效益高、后勤可靠的城池驻防方案。一台卓越的价钱，就足以把整整一个小队的城市机甲改装到 R8Q 标准。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双面间谍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the contract that Lady Marina wanted us to take, Commander. It seems fairly straightforward.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是玛丽娜女士希望我们接下的合约，指挥官. 看起来相当直接.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Federated Suns have constructed a forward base in the no-man's-land between their territory and ours on Flintoft's northern continent. We need you to eliminate their garrison and capture that base. We will remit payment when you've completed the job and secured the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联邦太阳国在弗林托夫特北部大陆、他们与我们领土之间的无人区建起了一处前进基地。我们需要你消灭其守军并夺取该基地。你完成任务并控制基地后，我们将支付款项。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领戴维恩前线基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture the base with friendly 'Mechs
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用友方机甲占领基地

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭基地炮塔

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭戴维恩家族的增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭戴维恩驻军

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护自己免受戴维恩的反击

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 肃清基地周边区域

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察戴维恩前沿基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip inbound, Commander! Prep for incoming!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投艇正在进场，指挥官！准备迎接敌人的增援！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Odds are good. But hey, heavier defenses mean better salvage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 胜算很大，不过防御越强战利品越好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Commander. I've set you down just outside the Davion base's assumed sensor range. With any luck, you'll have a little breathing room to plan your approach before everything goes to hell.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好了，指挥官。我已把你放在戴维恩基地假定传感器范围之外。运气好的话，你还能有点喘息时间，在一切失控之前规划好接近路线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That could complicate matters. The last thing we need is a Davion reinforcement lance swooping down on us before we can make the handoff. Dr. Murad, I need you to find a way to terminate that broadcast.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这可能会让事情复杂化. 我们最不希望的就是在交接完成前遭遇戴维恩援军的突袭. 穆拉德博士，我需要你设法切断传输.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Double Agent II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双面间谍 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW main enemy lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁 main enemy lance

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get ready, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. This is shaping up to be an interesting day.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 做好准备，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 这将是非常有趣的一天.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've received your message, and Maskirovka agents are on their way to take possession of the facility. Be advised that our long-range sensors have detected Davion and Taurian military DropShips en route to an AO near your position. To better protect the facility, we suggest that you engage them there. We'll supply you with reinforcements of our own as soon as we can.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到你的消息，伪装局干员正前往接管该设施。请注意，我们的远程传感器探测到达维昂与陶里安军用空投艇正前往你位置附近的行动区域。为了更好地保护该设施，我们建议你在那里与他们交战。我们会尽快为你提供增援。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送卡佩拉的小队到撤离点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All right, Commander. If our Capellan friends are to be believed, at least two groups of hostiles should be just ahead of you. They're as likely to shoot at one another as they are to shoot at you, so I imagine the situation's about to get a little chaotic down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，指挥官。如果我们的卡佩兰朋友所言属实，前方至少应该有两群敌人等着你。他们互相开火的可能性和朝你开火的概率差不多，所以我猜下面的局面马上要变得有点混乱了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Better them than us, I guess.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们比我们好，我会说.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander! Our Capellan reinforcements are touching down now!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官！我们的卡佩拉增援部队正在着陆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Oliveira. We're on station and will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's destroyed we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们已就位，将提供支援以完成主要目标。目标被摧毁后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The last of our Capellan allies just went down, Commander. Our lance is on its own.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们最后一个卡佩拉盟友刚刚被淘汰，指挥官. 我们的小队现在只剩自己了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander! Our Canopian reinforcements are touching down now!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官！我们的船底增援部队正在着陆！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roger that, Lance Leader. Good to have you on board.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，小队队长. 很高兴有你们加入.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The last of our Canopian allies just went down, Commander. Our lance is on its own.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们最后的船底盟友刚刚被淘汰，指挥官. 我们的小队现在只剩自己了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Security Solutions
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安全解决方案

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Security Solutions, Inc. is a certified threat deterrent and apprehension force.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安全解决方案有限公司是一支经过认证的威胁遏制与拘捕部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Security Solutions, Inc.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安全解决方案有限公司

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Security Solutions
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安全解决方案

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Darius pulls up beside you in a hurry. \"Commander you have to come to the Command Center. You're not going to believe it. We're on C.B.S\"

Darius smiles as you both make your way to the Command Center. 

\"This is a C.B.S. Breaking News Alert...The Capellan Confederation has extended an open bounty to five mercenary companies to hunt down and eliminate a rogue company of the Wolf's Dragoons for war crimes against the Confederation. The companies named by our exclusive source are Broadsword Legion, Gray's Ghosts, Lone Star Regiment, The Knights of Caerbannog  and {COMPANY.CompanyName}. The amount of the bounty has not been disclosed. But is reportedly very large.\"

Darius turns to you and asks. \"So {COMMANDER.FirstName}, are we going wolf hunting?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
达里乌斯匆匆赶上来与你并肩。"指挥官，你必须来指挥中心。你不会相信。我们上了C.B.S"

在你们一起走向指挥中心时，达里乌斯笑了。

"这是一条C.B.S突发新闻警报……卡佩兰联邦已向五支雇佣兵公司公开悬赏，要求追缉并消灭狼族龙骑兵的一支叛变连队，因其对联邦犯下战争罪行。据我方独家消息源称，被点名的公司有：大刀军团、格雷的幽灵、孤星团、卡厄班诺格骑士团，以及{COMPANY.CompanyName}。赏金金额尚未披露，但据报道非常庞大。"

达里乌斯转向你问道。"那么{COMMANDER.FirstName}，我们要去猎狼吗？"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Double Agent
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双面间谍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Capellan Confederation requires your assistance on a highly sensitive matter. Meet me at Flintoft, Commander. We'll discuss the details there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡佩兰联邦需要你协助一件高度敏感的事务。到弗林托夫特来见我，指挥官。我们到那里再谈细节。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Double Agent
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双面间谍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I need your help—my house's honor is at stake. Please, let's meet and discuss the details.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我需要你的帮助——我家族的荣誉悬于一线。拜托，我们见面谈谈细节。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A House Divided
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 家族内讧

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. You don't know me, but me and my associates have a job for you. A real nice one, with a big payout at the end. If you wanna talk about it, come meet me at Glentworth. I'll be waiting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官。你不认识我，但我和我的同伙有个活儿要给你。一件真正不错的活儿，最后有一大笔报酬。想谈的话，来格伦特沃斯见我。我会等着。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One Man's Trash
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他人之废

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Betrayed by their own organization
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被自己的组织背叛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander! I'm glad I was able to reach you. I have an opportunity for your company that pays extremely well. The only drawback is that it's located as far from civilization as it's possible to get without a JumpShip accident.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官！很高兴能联系上你。我有个给你们公司的机会，报酬极其优厚。唯一的缺点是它的位置在不通跃迁舰事故就尽可能远离文明的地方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Red Hunt
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 红色狩猎

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hearts and Minds
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 民心

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pro-Capellan insurgent group called the Emerald Dawn threatens to destabilize Shaunavon's political landscape. House Davion will reward you handsomely to neutralize this terrorist threat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个名叫“翡翠黎明”的亲卡佩兰叛乱组织威胁要动摇肖纳冯的政治格局。戴维恩家族会为消除这一恐怖威胁付你丰厚的报酬。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hearts and Minds
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 民心

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Late Split (3 way)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 后期分裂（3种方式）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: House Steiner has placed a Capellan city under military blockade. With your assistance, I intend to break the Lyran siege.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 施泰纳家族在卡佩拉城市周围设置了军事封锁. 我希望在你的帮助下打破天琴的围攻.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An associate of mine on Primus is in desperate need of assistance. If you're open to a little subcontracting, I'll make it worth your while.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在普里穆斯的一位同伙急需帮助。如果你愿意接点转包活，我会让你觉得值。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: lorem ipsum
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 逻辑推理

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your deeds on the field of battle have earned you an invitation to my Tournament of Champions. Join us, and take your place in the arena against the Periphery's fiercest warriors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你在战场上的事迹为你赢得了我的冠军锦标赛的邀请。加入我们，在竞技场中对阵外缘最凶悍的战士，占据你的一席之地！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tournament of Champions
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军锦标赛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Custom Linear FP
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自定义线性闪点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I have a highly delicate contract that requires your immediate attention. The task at hand is sensitive to the point that it cannot be discussed over an open channel. Meet me in the Duchy of Andurien and I'll fill you in on the details.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我有一份高度敏感的合约需要你立即处理。此事敏感到了无法在公开频道上讨论的程度。到安杜里恩公国来见我，我会把细节告诉你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Short Split Template
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 短拆分模板

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, Boss. I've got a line on a really juicy opportunity out on Electra, but I need to check it out in person to be sure. Think you could authorize taking a little detour?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，老大。我在伊莱克特拉上得到一条非常肥的机会的线索，但我得亲自去确认一下。你看能不能批准我们绕个小道？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yang Virtanen's Big Score
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杨·维尔塔宁的大收获

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A House Divided
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 家族内讧

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard Lady Suiko. Let's put Luthendorff down, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你听到水子小姐的话了。{COMMANDER.FirstName}，让我们把卢滕多夫放倒。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My daughter will arrive shortly at a private compound, and Luthendorff is on the way to greet her. Intercept and eliminate this criminal. But be on guard—she has bodyguards with her, although I expect you to easily outmaneuver and outsmart them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我女儿很快会抵达一处私人庄园，卢滕多夫正在前往迎接她的路上。拦截并消灭这个罪犯。但要提防——她身边带着保镖，不过我相信你能轻易地机动胜过、智取他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ambush and Eliminate Luthendorff
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伏击并消灭卢森道夫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方增援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Luthendorff
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭卢森道夫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get to the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent Luthendorff from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止卢森道夫逃跑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bold of you to charge for this kind of service, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你有很多胆量，为这样的服务要钱，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luthendorff is getting away, Commander. Run her down!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卢森道夫要跑了，指挥官. 追上去！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luthendorff will be forced to make her way through this pass. You can use that to catch her unawares.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卢森道夫不得不通过这个关口. 你可以利用这点打她个措手不及.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Of course she does.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 她当然会.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thanks for the pep talk, Lady Suiko. We can handle it from here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 感谢你的动员讲话，翠子夫人. 接下来就交给我们吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A House Divided II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 家族内讧 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Corina Luthdorff
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科琳娜·卢森道夫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lady Suiko Nakano
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中野翠子夫人

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's see what Lady Suiko's lance of geriatric MechWarriors can do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让我们看看水子小姐那支“高龄机甲战士”小队能做什么。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luthendorff will not escape death again, Commander. Don't expect an easy fight. This time she'll be prepared for us. I'm picking up multiple heavy contacts on my sensors. More scrap for Luthendorff's funeral pyre.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卢滕多夫不会再逃过一死，指挥官。别指望轻松的一战。这一次她会为我们做好准备。我在传感器上读到多个重型目标。又多了一批为卢滕多夫火葬堆添柴的废铁。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁卢滕多夫的部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate Luthendorff and Her Forces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭卢森道夫和她的部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ensure Lady Suiko Survives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保翠子夫人存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kill the comms. Enough talk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 切断通讯. 不必多言.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So, where's Lady Suiko and her lance of Third Succession War vets? Think they had trouble waking up from a nap?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那么，隋子夫人和她那支第三次继承战争老兵的队伍在哪儿？你想他们是午睡醒不过来吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A House Divided II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 家族内讧 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lady Suiko Nakano
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中野翠子夫人

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, let's see if we can hold off Lady Suiko's geriatric MechWarriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，我们来看看能不能挡住隋子夫人那些老掉牙的机师。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lady Suiko is inbound, and she's not alone. Her old war buddies are moving in fast-two lances of 'em. Keep in mind, we've got one goal: stop her from killing Luthendorff.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隋子夫人正在赶来，而且她不是一个人。她的老战友正快速靠拢——两支分队。记住，我们只有一个目标：阻止她杀死卢滕多夫。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Baddies Inbound
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌人来袭

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defeat Lady Suiko and Her Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 击败翠子夫人和她的第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Luthendorff
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫卢森道夫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend the Surrounding Structures
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫周围的建筑物

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out While Luthendorff Requests Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坚守，直到卢森道夫的增援到达

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Did I not make myself clear? Poverty is a small price to pay to retain our honor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可能我没说清楚?如果我们能保持我们的荣誉，那么贫穷是一个荒谬的代价.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators, and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送他们安全抵达发电机那里，一旦那些炮台启动，我们的防御能力就能提升. 祝你好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not that I expect you to understand. Your only loyalty is to your bank account. Kill the comms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我并不指望你能理解. 毕竟，你唯一的忠诚就是对你的银行账户. 结束通讯.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So, Commander, you've proven that your word means nothing. No matter. My comrades are hardened veterans, the embodiment of discipline and loyalty.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那么，指挥官，你已经证明你的承诺一文不值。无所谓。我的同志都是久经沙场的老兵，是纪律与忠诚的化身。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy of engineers eager to get at those defenses and bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个充满技术人员的盟军车队必须被护送到防御，以便他们可以被激活.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The UrbanMech IIC is a Clan IIC-style upgrade of the original UrbanMech. Around the same time as the development of the OmniMech during the Golden Century, Clan Coyote technicians reworked this venerable design. They studied battle data from as far back as the Amaris Civil War and used this research as the basis for their upgrades. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 都市机甲 IIC 是原版都市机甲的氏族 IIC 式升级。在黄金世纪全能机甲问世的同一时期，郊狼氏族技师重做了这一经典设计。他们研究了可追溯至阿马里斯内战的战斗数据，并以这些研究作为升级的基础。 特质：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：1.03 臂部驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UrbanMech IIC A
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 都市机甲 IIC A

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UrbanMech IIC A
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 都市机甲 IIC A

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The product of an aborted series of experiments into LAM technology, the Urbanmech LAM is not surprisingly; poorly suited for either role. Designed by the self proclaimed professor of Cluffs Stand, Mencius Horvat; using a mixture of stolen Urbanmech parts and Lostech recovered from throughout the Periphery. Slow by LAM standards and drastically under gunned by Urbanmech standards, this mech struggles to fill either role. That said, the shock factor of an Urbanmech LAM deployed against uninformed opponents, has allowed it a measure of success when used as a raider. Dual ER Mediums and a bevy of rockets provide a nasty punch at close quarters, but prove mediocre at longer ranges. The only known examples of this mech were were recovered by the DMI and were turned over to the NAIS, though their current status is unknown. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为 LAM 技术一系列中途夭折的实验的产物，Urbanmech LAM 哪一种角色都不适合，这一点并不令人意外。它由自称克拉夫斯站教授的门修斯·霍瓦特设计，材料是偷来的 Urbanmech 零件和从外围地区各地回收的失落科技。按 LAM 的标准它太慢，按 Urbanmech 的标准它的火力又严重不足，无论哪个角色都难以胜任。即便如此，把它派去对付毫无防备的对手时，其震撼效果让它在充当突袭者时取得了一定成功。双联增程中型激光加上一堆火箭，在近距离能打出凶狠的一击，但在较远距离上表现平平。已知仅存的几台此型机甲被 DMI 回收并移交给了 NAIS，不过它们目前的下落不明。 特性：陆空机甲 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UrbanMech LAM UM-LAM-A

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: UrbanMech LAM UM-LAM-A

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为城市近战而造的R61L，在它的廉价表亲R60L的AC20之外，还升级装上了隐形设备。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by Cataclysm, a former freeborn Clan Wolf MechWarrior turned Mercenary, and infamous UrbanMech fanatic, this refit is designed to be a cost-effective and logistically reliable way to garrison cities. For the price of a single Awesome, one could afford to refit an entire lance of UrbanMechs to the R8Q standard. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套改装由“灾变”（Cataclysm）设计——他曾是部族狼的自由出生机甲战士，后来成为雇佣兵，同时也是臭名昭著的都市机甲狂热爱好者——旨在提供一种经济实惠、后勤可靠的守城方案。以一台“超赞”（Awesome）的价钱，就足以把一整支都市机甲小队改装到 R8Q 标准。 特性：360° 躯干旋转 投放费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让所有玩家单位撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求让携带主要目标的单位存活。若其被摧毁玩家将失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to keep the unit which is carrying the secondary target alive. The player can fail this objective.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要且可选的目标：确保第二个救援目标安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well. This should be exciting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，这应该会很刺激.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've given your pilot a map of Men Lojowen, complete with the rough location of the Star League installation. I want you to get in there, brush aside any resistance, and loot whatever your BattleMechs can carry. You'll get your pay when my associates have the goods.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已给你的飞行员一份门洛乔恩的地图，上面标有星盟设施的粗略位置。我要你进去，扫开任何抵抗，把你们的战斗机甲能搬走的都搬走。等我的同伙拿到货，你就拿钱。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to Corbu's map, our Star League \"stapler factory\" should be somewhere just ahead of you. He also said that we shouldn't run up against anything more dangerous than a combat vehicle or two, but I'd take that with a grain of salt.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据科尔布的地图，我们那个星盟"订书机工厂"应该就在你前方某处。他还说我们最多只会撞上一两辆战斗车辆，但这话我还是打点折扣听。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: INCOMING TRANSMISSION.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到传输。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他人之废 II

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Corbu's time-share is in a civilian housing development, not a military base. We're gonna have to hustle if we want to protect it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科尔布的分时度假房在一处民用住宅区，不是军事基地。若想保护它，我们得赶紧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The last time I checked, Binton and Modge had a bunch of combat vehicles in the streets around my time-share. Maybe a light 'Mech or two, I can't say for sure. Get 'em off my back, and then we'll conclude our business with the antique staplers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我上次查看时，宾顿和莫奇在我分时住处周围的街上有一堆战斗车辆。也许还有一两台轻型机甲，我说不准。把他们从我的地盘上赶走，然后我们就可以用那些古董订书机了结我们的生意。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护埃德·科尔布的分时公寓

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators. We can boost our defensive capabilities with those turrets activated. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送他们安全抵达发电机那里，一旦那些炮台启动，我们的防御能力就能大幅提升. 祝你好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eyes up, Modge. Corbu's pet mercenaries are here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打起精神，莫奇。科尔布的宠物佣兵来了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: THERE IS NO TREASURE!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没有宝藏！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设置了炮台. 不过目前处于离线状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy of engineers eager to get at those defenses and bring them online.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主目标 ATTN 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Binton and Modge were fighting against each other on Men Lojowen. They may be allies of convenience for now, but I'll bet that'll change when they've got the \"treasure\" in their sights.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宾顿与莫吉在门洛乔文互相厮杀。他们眼下也许是因为利益而结盟，但我打赌等“宝藏”出现在视野里时就会变。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've told Binton and Modge that you're gonna drop their \"treasure\" in a field about a hundred klicks southeast of Louth Abbey. That should put you far enough away to avoid collateral damage, so feel free to go after 'em with whatever BattleMechs you like. Just be aware that there's nothing stopping them from doin' the same to you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已经告诉宾顿和莫奇，你要把他们那件"宝物"丢在劳斯修道院东南约一百公里外的一片田地里。这样你距离够远，可以避免附带损伤，所以尽管用你喜欢的任何战斗机甲去收拾他们。只是要知道，没有什么能阻止他们也这么对付你。
