Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌方雇佣兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eyes up, Modge. Corbu's pet mercenaries are here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打起精神，莫奇。科尔布的宠物佣兵来了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Huh. Whaddya know? There they are.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 呵，还真有. 箱子就在那儿.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Remind me to smack Ed for ever having hired this guy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提醒我以后绝对不能再雇这种疯子.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This seems simple enough, which makes me nervous. I don't like when we're asked to defend \"research\" without knowing what the research is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来够简单，反而让我紧张。我不喜欢在我们不知道研究内容的情况下被要求去防守"研究"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this installation is a vital part of Combine research efforts, and we need to ensure the enemy doesn't destroy it. We believe the opposing forces are a mercenary unit hired by our erstwhile allies in the Free Worlds League, and their intent is to disrupt the important work being done here. Your job will be to hold them off until they exhaust themselves, at which point we'll launch our own counterattack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这处设施是联合体研究工作的关键部分，我们必须确保敌人不会摧毁它。我们相信敌方部队是自由世界联盟（我们昔日的盟友）雇佣的一支雇佣兵，其意图是破坏这里正在进行的重要工作。你的任务将是顶住他们，直到他们力竭，届时我们会发起自己的反攻。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Additionally, our communications are being disrupted by a ground installation. We can relay messages through the Leopard, but only over short distances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此外，我们的通信正受到地面设施的干扰. 我们可以通过豹式中继消息，但范围受到严重限制.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators, and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送他们安全抵达发电机那里，一旦那些炮台启动，我们的防御能力就能提升. 祝你好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base. However, they are offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设置了炮台. 不过目前处于离线状态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To be completely honest with you, I haven't the faintest idea what kind of research goes on here. Nevertheless, a credible threat has been made. Your opposition is a mercenary company using the rather grandiose name \"[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGrayDeath],Gray Death Legion]].\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老实跟你说，我完全不知道这里进行的是哪一类研究。不过，威胁是可信的。你的对手是一家雇佣兵公司，用着相当浮夸的名字——"[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGrayDeath],灰死军团]]"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Red Hunt II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 红色狩猎 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gray Death
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 格雷死神

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only way we get off this planet and find out what kind of double cross the Kuritans are pulling here is to rescue Carlyle and his people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 要想离开这颗星球并揭穿栗田的阴谋，唯一的方法就是救出卡莱尔和他的部下.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It looks like we're both on the Kurita shit list, Commander. This situation is bad and getting worse. My people are pinned down by fire from the DEST forces, and we can't use our Leopard to get into orbit. We've evacuated the Fire Lance, but the Command Lance is still stuck on-world—which concerns me personally, because I'm part of the Command Lance and one of the people who's stuck. I want to get to the bottom of this mess, but I'm going to need your help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们俩都在栗田的黑名单上了，指挥官。这局面很糟，而且还在恶化。我的人被DEST部队的火力压制住，我们没法用豹式进入轨道。我们已经撤离了火力分队，但指挥分队还困在行星上——这让我个人很担心，因为我就是指挥分队的一员，也是被困的人之一。我想把这团乱麻查个水落石出，但我需要你的帮助。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫格雷森·卡莱尔的部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Additional DEST Team
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁额外的DEST部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy DEST Team
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁DEST部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another DEST lance just deployed, Commander. Getting hot down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支DEST机甲小队刚刚部署，指挥官. 地面战况正在升温.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carlyle. This is Darius Oliveira, XO of the Argo. We need some answers about what just happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡莱尔。我是达里乌斯·奥利维拉，阿戈号的执行官。关于刚才发生的事，我们需要一些答案。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Duke Ricol sends his regards, Carlyle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 里科尔公爵向你问好，卡莱尔.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 红色狩猎 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As long as Carlyle's people can handle their part of this operation, we shouldn't have any trouble destroying the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要卡莱尔的人能处理好他们那部分，我们摧毁基地应该没有麻烦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're prepared to start our assault on the ComStar facility. Before we make our move, we need you to take out that military base, so that DEST can't coordinate a response. Once that base is rubble, give us the all clear. Then we'll commence our attack, break in there, and broadcast the signal to Tor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已准备好对通讯之星设施发起进攻。动手之前，我们需要你拔掉那座军事基地，这样DEST就无法协调应对。基地一旦变成瓦砾，就通知我们。随后我们将发起攻击，突入其中，并向托尔广播信号。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁基地的防御者

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁房子栗田军事基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Kurita Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁房屋栗田增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁栗田军事基地

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carlyle, you are clear to begin your assault.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carlyle，你可以开始你的攻击了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roger that. Here comes some ass kicking, courtesy of the Gray Death Legion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到. 接下来就让格雷死神军团来大显身手吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kurita base is just ahead, Commander. All we have to do is get in there, level the place, and get out again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 栗田基地就在前方，指挥官. 我们要做的就是冲进去，把那地方夷为平地，然后再撤出来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Red Hunt III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 红色狩猎 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As long as Carlyle's people can handle their part of this operation, we shouldn't have any trouble taking the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要卡莱尔的人能处理好他们那部分，我们拿下这座基地应该不会有麻烦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're starting our assault. As soon as we take out the Combine military base, the Kuritans will lose their ability to coordinate a response. That's your cue to move in and capture the ComStar facility, shut down the jamming gear DEST set up there, and get our signal broadcasting. We've got a pretty big window before Tor leaves again, so the only hurry is that our DEST friends aren't going to sit on their hands after we start shooting at them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们开始进攻了。我们一摧毁联合体的军事基地，栗田人就会失去协调应对的能力。那时你就该行动，夺取康星设施，关停DEST在那里设置的干扰设备，让我们的信号播出去。在托尔再次离开之前我们有相当大的时间窗口，所以唯一要赶的就是：我们一开始朝他们开火，我们那些DEST朋友就不会干坐着。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: DropShip inbound for landing! We're going to get in and out quick!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 空投舰正在降落！我们要速进速出！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Occupy the facility and take care of any additional DEST forces that show up. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领设施并清除所有出现的DEST增援部队. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shit. We dropped the ball on this one, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该死. 我们搞砸了，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kurita military outpost is rubble, Commander. You're clear to begin your assault. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 栗田军事前哨已成瓦砾，指挥官。你可以放心开始进攻了。祝好运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You should be able to see the ComStar facility from here, Commander. Looks like DEST got the base turrets running, as we suspected.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你应该能从这里看到ComStar设施，指挥官. 看来DEST果然启动了基地的炮台.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This all sounds pretty straightforward, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Keep your eyes open, all the same.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听起来相当明确，{COMMANDER.FirstName}. 但务必保持警惕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Matis \"Bishop\" Crenshaw and his retinue are en route to a meeting with Sian Triumphant, a satellite organization of the Emerald Dawn. Intercept Crenshaw's BattleMech, destroy it, and contact my DropShip to confirm the kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马蒂斯"主教"克伦肖及其随从正在前往与"西安胜利者"会面的途中——那是翠绿黎明的一个卫星组织。拦截克伦肖的战斗机甲，将其摧毁，然后联系我的空投艇确认击杀。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁翡翠黎明先锋部队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭马蒂斯·“主教”·克伦肖

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止目标逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proceed to the evac zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: CONNECTION LOST.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 连接中断.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Does the timing of that feel a little suspicious to anyone else, or is it just me?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 时间对任何人来说都是西班牙式的还是只是我自己?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: INCOMING TRANSMISSION.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到传输。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've been picking up sporadic hits on the Leopard's sensors, Commander. Lady Cunningham was right; Crenshaw is definitely moving through this AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在豹式的传感器上不断读到零散的信号，指挥官。坎宁安女士说得对；克伦肖确实正在穿过这一行动区域。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch one Emerald Dawn combat lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一支来自翡翠黎明的机甲小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So much for keeping in touch with our client.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这下跟雇主保持联络的计划也泡汤了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hearts and Minds II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 民心 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Emerald Dawn Irregular
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 翡翠黎明民兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sometimes you're left with nothing but bad options. This is one of those times, but we're professionals, and it's on us to handle it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有时你只剩下糟糕的选项。这就是那种时候，但我们是专业人士，这活儿该我们扛。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tiesa \"Navaja\" Norkus has holed up in the Emerald Dawn's most heavily fortified stronghold, and she's using a number of civilian hostages as human shields. Unfortunately, there isn't much that we can do for those people; Lady Cunningham has made it very clear that eliminating the Emerald Dawn's leadership is imperative, and it'll be impossible for us to take out Norkus without incurring collateral damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒂莎"剃刀"诺库斯窝藏在翠绿黎明防御最严密的据点里，并用多名平民人质作为人盾。不幸的是，我们为那些人做不了什么；坎宁安女士已经非常明确地表示，除掉翠绿黎明的领导层是必须的，而我们不可能在不造成附带损伤的情况下拿下诺库斯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your Davion masters aren't going to like this, scum. There are two dozen flag-waving Federation citizens in here who're gonna wind up in pieces if you don't stand down now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你们的达维昂主子不会喜欢这个的，渣滓。这里面有两打挥舞旗帜的联邦公民，你要是不放下武器，他们就会变成碎块。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hearts and Minds II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 民心 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Even if we can't cut the head off the Emerald Dawn, we should be able to inflict a lot of damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 即便我们无法斩掉翠绿黎明的头颅，也应该能造成大量损伤。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We may not be able to take out Tiesa Norkus, but at least we can contain her. If she wants to hide behind human shields, fine—let her hide. We'll do as much damage to the Emerald Dawn as we can, and when Lady Cunningham's DropShip touches down, she can handle the hostage negotiations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们也许无法除掉蒂莎·诺库斯，但至少能困住她。如果她想躲在人盾后面，行——就让她躲着。我们要尽可能重创翠绿黎明，等坎宁安女士的空投艇降落，她可以处理人质谈判。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Sian Triumphant Forces
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭仙安凯旋的部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keeping your distance, Commander? Good choice. You get any closer and I'll start throwing these traitors out a 30th-floor window. They'll have plenty of time to regret their mistakes before they splatter against the pavement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保持距离，指挥官？明智的选择。你再靠近一点，我就把这些叛徒从30层楼的窗户扔出去。他们在摔上人行道之前会有充足时间后悔自己的错误。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're talking about House Steiner here. Considering the context, \"scout\" may not mean what we think it means.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们说的是施泰纳家族。考虑到语境，“侦察”可能不是我们想的意思。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For your first deployment, you will rendezvous with Azura \"Cheval\" Damestroir of the Mitchel Planetary Militia. She and her lance have been scout-hunting in northern Gauthier's wealthy Museum District, and it appears that they've caught a Lyran scout. Assist her lance in defeating it, then proceed to your next rendezvous point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的首次部署，你将与米切尔行星民兵的艾祖拉"谢瓦尔"·达梅斯特罗尔会合。她和她的分队一直在北加蒂埃富裕的博物馆区猎杀侦察兵，看起来他们逮住了一名莱兰侦察兵。协助她的分队击败它，然后前往下一个会合点。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。我是艾祖拉·达梅斯特罗尔中尉。感谢你的协助，因为我们确实需要。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These Lyrans are packing too much heat, Commander. Lieutenant Damestroir and her lance have been destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些天琴人的火力太猛了，指挥官. 戴米斯托尔中尉及其小队已全军覆没.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: \"Former militia member and paroled felon.\" I think I'm getting why Cheval doesn't trust her.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "前民兵成员、已假释的重罪犯。"我想我开始明白谢瓦尔为什么不信任她了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your next objective is in Jessup Downs, on the far side of Gauthier. Your point of contact, a former militia member and paroled felon who operates under the callsign \"Jailbird,\" has been holding the Downs with no outside support for nearly a month. She has reported signs of a heavy Steiner patrol lance moving through the area. I need you to assist her in bringing down that patrol.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的下一个目标在加蒂埃远侧的杰瑟普丘陵。你的接头人是一名前民兵成员、已假释的重罪犯，代号"狱鸟"，她在几乎没有外部支援的情况下守住了丘陵将近一个月。她报告说发现一支施泰纳重型巡逻分队正穿过该地区。我需要你协助她击溃那支巡逻队。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁额外的施泰纳部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate Steiner Heavy Patrol
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭重型施泰纳巡逻队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate the Steiner Heavy Patrol
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭施泰纳重型巡逻队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beautiful work, Commander! Scratch one Steiner heavy patrol!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 出色的工作，指挥官！重型施泰纳巡逻队已成为历史！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. We've been waiting for you. Welcome to Jessup Downs, the unofficial armpit of Gauthier.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。我们一直在等你。欢迎来到杰瑟普丘陵，加蒂埃非官方的胳肢窝。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For some reason, the Lyrans have seen fit to send one of their heavy patrols in our direction. We could use your help to eliminate it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 出于某种原因，天琴人向我们派出了一支重型巡逻队. 我们需要你的帮助来消灭它.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jailbird is down, Commander. Repeat, Jailbird is down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “监狱鸟”倒下了，指挥官. 重复一遍: “监狱鸟”倒下了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mission successful, Commander. Time to get out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务成功，指挥官. 该撤离这里了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: On what charge?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以什么罪名?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roger that, Oliveira. Jailbird out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，奥利维拉. “监狱鸟”完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 破围者 III

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 至少 1 个必须存活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm glad we're gonna have Cheval and her lance on our side for this, but we should keep our eyes open for Jailbird. She didn't sound like she was planning on sitting this one out quietly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我很高兴这次有谢瓦尔和她的分队站在我们这边，但我们得留心'狱鸟'。听她的口气，她可没打算安安静静地缺席这场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Even with a portion of Dobrescu's sentries out chasing shadows in the Museum District, the Ziegelhaus will be heavily defended. You'll need to hit the structure hard, while at the same time protecting Militia HQ from an expected Steiner counterattack. Good hunting, Commander. Show Hauptmann-General Dobrescu that his excesses will not be tolerated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 即便多布雷库已把部分哨兵派去博物馆区追查虚影，齐格尔豪斯仍会有重兵防守。你需要在猛攻该建筑的同时，保护民兵总部免遭预料之中的施泰纳反攻。狩猎愉快，指挥官。让豪普特曼将军多布雷库明白，他的暴行不会被容忍。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has landed nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队已在附近着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, enemy turrets identified.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，已识别敌方炮塔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我发现区域内有敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 单位。我们的目标叫来了盟友助阵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got a lance of enemy forces moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander: another Steiner lance has just entered the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官: 又一个施泰纳小队刚刚进入行动区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I see you, little militiamen. You think to come for me, eh? I salute your courage, but your efforts are doomed to failure. And when my BattleMechs crush you under their feet, I will tighten my grasp around Gauthier. You will surrender what is mine, or your city will starve.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我瞧见你们了，小民兵们. 想打我的主意? 我佩服你们的勇气，但你们的努力注定徒劳. 当我的战斗机甲把你们碾在脚下时，我必将收紧对高蒂尔的掌控. 要么乖乖交出属于我的东西，要么眼睁睁看着你们的城市陷入饥荒.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: INCOMING TRANSMISSION.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到传输。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Just keep an eye on the militia buildings until you leave the field. You know, just in case.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只需在撤离战场前确保民兵建筑安全. 你知道的——以防万一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Look out, Commander. Another wave of Steiner units just appeared on my screen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官. 又一批施泰纳部队出现在我的屏幕上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roger that, Cheval. Keep us posted on your situation, and call out if you need help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，“骑士”. 随时通报你们的情况，如需支援请呼叫.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Structure down, Commander! Press on, and that whole fortification is history!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 结构已摧毁，指挥官！继续，整个防御工事即将成为历史！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ziegelhaus is down, Commander. Repeat, the Ziegelhaus is down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 砖房已被摧毁，指挥官. 重复一遍: 砖房已被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They're coming in fast, don't let them get too close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们来得很快，别让他们靠得太近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander—our chance to break the siege. I hope that your people are ready for this, because we may never get another opportunity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这一下了，指挥官——我们打破围困的机会。我希望你的人为此准备好了，因为我们可能再也不会得到另一个机会。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch out commander, more hostiles are arriving. They'll be landing in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，指挥官，更多敌人正在赶来。他们将在这一带着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队已在附近着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Appreciate it, Jailbird. Call out if you need our help.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 谢了，“监狱鸟”. 需要支援就喊话.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, enemy turrets identified.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，已识别敌方炮塔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我发现区域内有敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 单位。我们的目标叫来了盟友助阵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got a lance of enemy forces moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander: another Steiner lance has just entered the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官: 又一个施泰纳小队刚刚进入行动区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I see you, little militiamen. You think to come for me, eh? I salute your courage, but your efforts are doomed to failure. And when my BattleMechs crush you under their feet, I will tighten my grasp around Gauthier. You will surrender what is mine, or your city will starve.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我瞧见你们了，小民兵们. 想打我的主意? 我佩服你们的勇气，但你们的努力注定徒劳. 当我的战斗机甲把你们碾在脚下时，我必将收紧对高蒂尔的掌控. 要么乖乖交出属于我的东西，要么眼睁睁看着你们的城市陷入饥荒.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: INCOMING TRANSMISSION.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到传输。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Just keep an eye on the militia buildings until you leave the field. You know, just in case.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只需在撤离战场前确保民兵建筑安全. 你知道的——以防万一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Look out, Commander. Another wave of Steiner units just appeared on my screen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官. 又一批施泰纳部队出现在我的屏幕上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Structure down, Commander! Press on, and that whole fortification is history!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 结构已摧毁，指挥官！继续，整个防御工事即将成为历史！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ziegelhaus is down, Commander. Repeat, the Ziegelhaus is down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 砖房已被摧毁，指挥官. 重复一遍: 砖房已被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They're coming in fast, don't let them get too close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们来得很快，别让他们靠得太近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander. There's a gang of big metal bastards between us and Dobrescu, and then we'll have a mountain of steel to get through. But I think we can do it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这一下了，指挥官。我们和多布雷库之间有一帮大金属混蛋，然后还有一座钢铁之山要穿过去。但我觉得我们能做到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch out commander, more hostiles are arriving. They'll be landing in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，指挥官，更多敌人正在赶来。他们将在这一带着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Siegebreaker III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 破围者 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At least 1 must survive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 至少 1 个必须存活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attack and Defend
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 攻守兼备

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used to show players where the escape region is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于向玩家显示逃脱区域的位置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're going it alone on this one, so we shouldn't have any infighting to worry about. That's a good thing, because we're gonna be outnumbered enough as it is.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一票我们得独自干，所以不用担心内讧。这是好事，因为我们已经够寡不敌众了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Even with a portion of Dobrescu's sentries out chasing shadows in the Museum District, the Ziegelhaus will be heavily defended. You'll need to hit the structure hard, while at the same time protecting Militia HQ from an expected Steiner counterattack. Good hunting, Commander. Show Hauptmann-General Dobrescu that his excesses will not be tolerated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 即便多布雷库已把部分哨兵派去博物馆区追查虚影，齐格尔豪斯仍会有重兵防守。你需要在猛攻该建筑的同时，保护民兵总部免遭预料之中的施泰纳反攻。狩猎愉快，指挥官。让豪普特曼将军多布雷库明白，他的暴行不会被容忍。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the enemy base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我看到敌方基地周围有敌对守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got a lance of enemy forces moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander: another Steiner lance has just entered the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官: 又一个施泰纳小队刚刚进入行动区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I see you, little militiamen. You think to come for me, eh? I salute your courage, but your efforts are doomed to failure. And when my BattleMechs crush you under their feet, I will tighten my grasp around Gauthier. You will surrender what is mine, or your city will starve.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我瞧见你们了，小民兵们. 想打我的主意? 我佩服你们的勇气，但你们的努力注定徒劳. 当我的战斗机甲把你们碾在脚下时，我必将收紧对高蒂尔的掌控. 要么乖乖交出属于我的东西，要么眼睁睁看着你们的城市陷入饥荒.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: INCOMING TRANSMISSION.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到传输。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Just keep an eye on the militia buildings until you leave the field. You know, just in case.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只需在撤离战场前确保民兵建筑安全. 你知道的——以防万一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Look out, Commander. Another wave of Steiner units just appeared on my screen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官. 又一批施泰纳部队出现在我的屏幕上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer wants us to kill these guys. This mission isn't ending until they die.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主想让我们干掉这些人。他们不死，这任务就不算结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scratch another target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Structure down, Commander! Press on, and that whole fortification is history!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 结构已摧毁，指挥官！继续，整个防御工事即将成为历史！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has provided some of their own forces to support us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 派出了自己的一些部队来支援我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ziegelhaus is down, Commander. Repeat, the Ziegelhaus is down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 砖房已被摧毁，指挥官. 重复一遍: 砖房已被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They can handle it. Our people are professionals, and we can trust them. That puts them a step ahead of Cheval and Jailbird.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们能应付. 我们的员工都是专业人士，值得信赖. 这使他们比“骑士”和“监狱鸟”更可靠.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They're coming in fast, don't let them get too close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们来得很快，别让他们靠得太近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander. I'm picking up a lot of sensor activity around the Ziegelhaus. Our lance is in for a hell of a fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这一下了，指挥官。我在齐格尔豪斯周围读到大量传感器活动。我们分队要打一场恶仗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Watch out commander, more hostiles are arriving. They'll be landing in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心，指挥官，更多敌人正在赶来。他们将在这一带着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy enemy Ambushers before extraction
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离前摧毁敌方伏击部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional forces Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌军，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When Lady Helen gives Yamaguchi what he wants, we get paid. Let's get to it, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等海伦女士给了山口他想要的，我们就能拿到报酬。开始动手吧，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander Yuetu and her Red Hare Irregulars have proven an intolerable threat to my interests and to the future of House Khulan. I need you to hunt her down and destroy her BattleMech, an \"Orion,\" I believe it's called. Smash it to pieces and bring me proof of Yuetu's death, and I will lend Shugo Yamaguchi my support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 月兔指挥官和她的红兔非正规军已被证明是对我利益和库兰家族未来的不可容忍威胁。我需要你追猎她并摧毁她的战斗机甲——我想它叫"猎户座"。把它砸成碎片，并把月兔死亡的证据带给我，我就会把支持借给山口修护。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭赤兔军的雇佣兵

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭月兔指挥官并撤离

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭月兔指挥官

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭赤兔军的增援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent the Target from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止目标逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target down, Commander.  A nice, clean kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标已倒下，指挥官. 漂亮一击，干净利落.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait. Your mother?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等一下. 你妈妈?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We still may be able to catch up with her ejection pod if you hurry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果动作快点，我们或许还能追上她的逃生舱.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, she sounds confident.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，她听起来很自信.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're getting an incoming transmission, Commander. Looks like our target has something to say.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有来电通讯，指挥官。看来我们的目标有话要说。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Succession II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 继承人 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lady Yvonne \"Yuetu\" Khulan
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “月兔”胡兰夫人

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We promised Shugo Yamaguchi we'd do this. May as well get it over with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们答应过山口修护要做这件事。不如就把它办了吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The vile mercenary Yuetu is on her last legs. Cut them out from under her! Safeguard my beloved son, and prevent our enemies from destroying House Khulan. If you do, I will see to Reynauld's needs, and he in turn will see to yours.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那卑劣的雇佣兵月兔已经走投无路了。把她脚下的路砍断！保护我心爱的儿子，阻止我们的敌人摧毁库兰家族。如果你做到，我会照顾雷诺德的需要，而他则会照顾你的。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm setting you down at Yuetu's last known coordinates, Commander. She should be close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我把你投放在月兔最后一次已知坐标，指挥官。她应该就在附近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're taking a gamble on this one, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. But given our options, it's one that I can live with.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一票我们是在赌，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。但考虑到我们的选项，这是我愿意承受的一场赌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You'll find my brother waiting for you at the Red Roost. It looks like a commercial office park, but don't be fooled. The structure is reinforced to withstand military payloads. Engage my brother's security team and raze the Red Roost. Let his stronghold serve as his tomb!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我弟弟会在红鸡舍等你。它看着像个商业办公园区，但别被骗了。那结构经过加固，能承受军用弹药。与我弟弟的安保队交战，把红鸡舍夷为平地。让他的据点成为他的坟墓！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁安格斯·库兰领主的据点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we're in the right place, Commander. Lord Angus Khulan is hailing us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们来对地方了，指挥官。安格斯·库兰领主正在呼叫我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You can thank us by lending Shugo Yamaguchi your support, like you promised you would.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你可以通过向山口修吾提供支持来表示感谢——就像你承诺的那样.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tournament of Champions
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军锦标赛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Basilisk Jackson
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴吉里斯克·杰克逊

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Jake Saito
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斋藤杰克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Urbie is basically a walking dustbin with a big gun. That weapon packs a hell of a punch, but it's only so long till it's a paperweight. Keep an eye on those heat gauges, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市仔基本上就是个会走路的垃圾桶配一门大炮。那武器打击力惊人，但迟早会变成一个镇纸。盯紧那些热量表，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Welcome to my Tournament, Commander. Here you will prove your mettle against the Periphery's fiercest champions. Today, your MechWarriors will demonstrate their worth using only the simplest of tools: the UrbanMech. Like a huntsman's spear, it is an instrument with a single purpose. Wield it skillfully, and ascend into triumph.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欢迎来到我的锦标赛，指挥官。在此你将与外缘最凶悍的冠军们较量本事。今天，你的机师们将只用最简单的工具来证明自己的价值：城市机甲。它就像猎人的长矛，是一件只有单一用途的器具。娴熟地挥舞它，登上胜利之巅。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Win the first round of the Tournament
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赢得锦标赛第一轮胜利

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: MECHWARRIORS! You stand alone in the carcass of an abandoned city. This sepulchre of commerce is now reborn as a hunting ground and field of battle, all at the command of my master, PROFESSOR MENCIUS HORVAT!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲战士们！你们独自矗立在一座废弃城市的残骸中。这座商业的坟墓如今重获新生，成为猎场与战场——这一切都听命于我的主人，孟修斯·霍瓦特教授！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冠军锦标赛 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mencius Horvat
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 孟修斯·霍瓦特

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Horvat's going to stack the odds against us, just like Agent Jones said. If we're going to do this, our MechWarriors will have to be ready.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 正如琼斯特工所说，霍瓦特会给我们设下不利的局面。若要动手，我们的机甲战士必须做好准备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Welcome to the final round of my Tournament, Commander. Today, your two finest pilots will face off against the cream of the Frontier MechWarrior community. This will be a battle like no other, a clash between veritable gods. I wish your fighters luck, Commander—and I promise you, they will need it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 欢迎来到我锦标赛的最后一轮，指挥官。今天，你最出色的两名飞行员将对阵边疆机甲战士社区的精英。这将是一场前所未有的战斗，一场名副其实的神明之间的碰撞。祝你的战士们好运，指挥官——我向你保证，他们会需要的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: She got through that entire briefing without saying, \"The hunter will become the hunted.\" I'm pleasantly surprised.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 她整场简报下来居然没说过"猎人将成为猎物"。这倒是让我惊喜。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Professor Mencius Horvat is waiting for you in the Tournament arena. He expects you to play by his rules—to let him lead a pair of your MechWarriors like lambs to the slaughter. Instead, you're going to show him the kind of firepower that your company can really bring down. Destroy him, and the MIIO will reward you accordingly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 孟修斯·霍瓦特教授正在锦标赛竞技场等你。他指望你按他的规则行事——让他像牵羊入屠宰场一样带走你的两名机甲战士。而你，要让他见识你的连队真正能倾泻怎样的火力。干掉他，MIIO 会给予相应的回报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So, {COMMANDER.Callsign}. You have elected to violate the rules of my Tournament. You've decided to kill me, perhaps? To take on the great hunter in his den?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那么，{COMMANDER.Callsign}。你选择违反我锦标赛的规则。也许你已决定杀我？要在伟大猎人的巢穴中挑战他？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard the man. Let's go make ourselves useful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你听到他的话了。咱们去干点正事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For your first deployment, you will take the field alongside Ombra and the rest of Bravo Lance. Together, you will sweep the AO for hostiles, eliminating any Capellan units you find along the way. Bravo Lance has endured a great deal of punishment over the past few months and will need your help to come through this deployment in one piece.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在你第一次出击时，你将与Ombra和Bravo小队的其他成员一起上战场. 你们将共同清扫敌军，消灭途中遇到的任何卡佩拉单位. Bravo小队在过去的几个月中承受了巨大的损失，这次任务将需要你的帮助，确保他们能顺利完成，并完好无损地回归.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁廖氏援军

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭施泰纳突击小队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送Bravo小队到撤离点

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 支援并保护Bravo小队

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡佩拉的增援?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Please contact me when you reach a safe altitude. We need to talk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}. 请在达到安全高度后立即联系我. 我们需要谈谈.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Here we are, XO—scenic New Jakobstad, the shiniest combat zone on Fagerholm. I've got Bravo Lance on the comms, and their Drop Pods are prepared to launch. Are you reading us, Ombra?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们到了，副官——风景如画的新雅各布斯塔德，法格霍尔姆最闪亮的战区。布拉沃小队在通讯里，他们的投放舱已准备发射。能听到我们吗，翁布拉？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I hate parties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我讨厌派对.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: INCOMING MESSAGE.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到一条来电.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lyrans. It looks like House Steiner has decided to join the party.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天琴人. 看起来施泰纳家族也决定加入派对了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No problem, Viscacha. Force Commander Singh will be pleased that you made it through.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没问题，兔鼠. 辛格司令会很高兴，你做到了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The AO is clear, everybody. All hostile contacts down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动区域已清理. 所有敌人都被消灭了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prototype II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's make this strike quickly, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. Bravo Lance will be holding off the Capellans while we work, and I don't want to leave them out there any longer than I have to.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们快点打完这一击，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。布拉沃分队会在我们干活时拖住卡佩兰人，我不想让他们在外面多待一分钟。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to Ombra, a Black Caldera convoy has been scheduled to pass through the badlands north of New Jakobstad. Engage the convoy and destroy it. Bravo Lance will then interface with the command vehicle's black box to obtain the location of the Raven prototype, as well as the R&D facility Black Caldera has been using to reverse engineer it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据翁布拉说，一支黑破火山口车队已安排要穿过新雅各布斯塔德北部的荒地。与车队交战并将其摧毁。布拉沃分队随后会接入指挥车辆的黑匣子，获取渡鸦原型机的位置，以及黑破火山口一直用来逆向工程它的研发设施。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Employers Ally
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neutral to All
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有人中立

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Black Caldera Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁黑色火山口的增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Black Caldera Convoy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁黑色火山口车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Convoy Guards
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队护卫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Convoy Guards.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prevent the Convoy from Escaping
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阻止车队逃跑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proceed to the evac zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Black Caldera BattleMechs down, Commander. Focus your fire on those transports!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑色火山口的战斗机甲已被击毁，指挥官. 集中火力攻击那些运输船！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Commander. According to Ombra, this convoy will be carrying a black box with data on the locations of the stolen Raven and Black Caldera Defense's secret R&D lab.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，指挥官。据翁布拉说，这支车队将携带一个黑匣子，里面有被盗渡鸦以及黑破火山口防务秘密研发实验室位置的数据。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our window of opportunity is closing, Commander. You need to stop those transports before they depart the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 留给我们的时间不多了，指挥官. 你需要在那两艘空投艇离开任务区域之前阻止它们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prototype III
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型 III

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ombra died for this, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. It's on us to make sure that her sacrifice counts for something.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 翁布拉为此而死，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。我们必须确保她的牺牲有意义。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to the intel we found, Black Caldera Defense is storing their stolen Raven prototype at an old armory in southern New Jakobstad. We need to capture the base and recover the prototype. Conqueror, Viscacha, and Peregrine will be standing by to carry out the second half of the operation when we're done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据我们找到的情报，黑破火山口防务把他们偷来的渡鸦原型机存放在新雅各布斯塔德南部的一处旧军械库里。我们需要夺取基地并回收原型机。征服者、毛丝鼠和游隼将待命，等我们完成前半段后执行行动的后半段。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture the Armory to Recover the Prototype Raven
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领军械库，找回“渡鸦”原型机

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Black Caldera Garrison
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁黑色火山口驻军

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭基地炮塔

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌军反攻时坚守

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 平定设施周边区域

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夺回“渡鸦”原型机

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察黑色火山口的军械库

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Commander. According to our intel, the Raven is being stored in a dilapidated armory in this part of the city. The OpFor's unit strength is unknown, but I bet it'll be somewhere between \"a lot\" and \"way too much.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好的，指挥官。据我们的情报，那台渡鸦存放在城中这一片的一座破败军械库里。敌方兵力不明，但我打赌大概在“很多”到“多得离谱”之间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prototype IV
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 原型 IV

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Structures and Extract Safely
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方建筑并安全撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Handle this and we're done here, {COMMANDER.FirstName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把这事办完我们就完事了，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to the intel we found, Black Caldera's hardened R&D facility is protected by a phalanx of LRM batteries. Using the Raven's unique capabilities, you will protect Bravo Lance from these weapons while leading them to destroy the facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据我们找到的情报，黑破火山口的加固研发设施由一排LRM炮组保护。利用渡鸦的独特能力，你将在带领布拉沃分队摧毁该设施时，保护他们免受这些武器的攻击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Black Caldera Garrison
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁黑色火山口驻军

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Black Caldera R&D Facility
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁黑色火山口研究实验室

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate Black Caldera Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭黑色火山口的增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Proceed to the evac zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good riddance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 幸运的是.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, Commander. The Black Caldera facility should lie just ahead of us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这里，指挥官. Black Caldera的设施应该就在我们前方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yang Virtanen's Big Score
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杨·维尔塔宁的大收获

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chunk controlled objective to destroy the turrets for the base, if the chunk is active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该由区块控制的目标负责摧毁基地的炮塔（若该区块处于激活状态）。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to move into and capture the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家推进并占领基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to optionally destroy the defenders of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：摧毁基地的守军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to scout the base that is being captured. Must be completed before the actual capture of the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's hope this heist works out the way Yang said that it would.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 但愿这次劫案能像杨说的那样顺利。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wallo's got a mercenary company on retainer to protect his private aerospace hangar, the imaginatively named \"Security Solutions, Inc.\" I looked 'em up, and they're the real deal—they've got combat vehicles, BattleMechs, the works. But we'll have the element of surprise on our side, given that Wallo's never heard of us. That's something, right?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瓦洛雇了一家雇佣兵公司常驻保护他的私人航空机库，名字起得很有想象力，叫"安保解决方案公司"。我查过他们，他们是真家伙——有战斗车辆、战斗机甲，全套。但我们会有奇袭之利，因为瓦洛从没听说过我们。这也算点东西，对吧？

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对所有势力敌对

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察机库

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogeys on sensors!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: INCOMING TRANSMISSION.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到传输。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The hangar is defenseless, and it looks like Graves is taking the bait. Long-range sensors are picking up activity out by his showroom.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机库已毫无防备，格雷夫斯似乎上钩了. 远程传感器探测到他的展厅外有动静.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The hangar's just ahead, Commander. I'm picking up a lot of BattleMech activity out front.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机库就在前方，指挥官。我在门口读到大量战斗机甲活动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yang Virtanen's Big Score II
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 杨·维尔塔宁的大收获 II

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ATTN ANDREW
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's protect that merchandise, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. It's what we're doing this for, after all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护好那批货物，{COMMANDER.FirstName}。毕竟我们就是为这个来的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Boss! We've got the hot rods, and we're on our way to the LZ. Did I mention that I still hate rumble seats? Boy, do I ever! You'd better get on the comms to guide us through this—we're moving at a solid clip, but I suspect we're being followed…
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好的，老板！热车已经到手，我们正在前往着陆点。我说过我还是讨厌简易座椅吗？天哪，我真是太讨厌了！你最好用通讯指引我们穿过这一带——我们跑得挺快，但我怀疑有人跟着我们……

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭格雷夫斯的安保小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eliminate Paladin Protection LLC reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭圣骑士安保LLC的增援部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your Entire Lance must survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的整个小队必须存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got problems down here. Graves's security team is closing in on us, and we're gonna have to fight our way out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们这边出事了。格雷夫斯的安保小队正逼近我们，我们得杀出一条路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, Boss! We've got the monster trucks, and we're slugging our way to the LZ. Did I mention that I still hate rumble seats? Boy, do I ever! You'd better get on the comms to guide us through this; we're trudging along at a steady pace, but we're about to have company…
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，老大！我们弄到怪兽卡车了，正一路轰着往着陆区去。我说过我讨厌颠簸座吗？天哪，我可真是讨厌！你最好赶紧上通讯引导我们穿过这里；我们正以稳定速度艰难前行，但马上要有客人来了……
